primary_question: Does the complete reviewed-context pipeline improve clean task completion over strong hybrid retrieval and reranking at acceptable total cost?

provisional_confirmatory_design.power_analysis: Required before held-out test unlock; use feasibility estimates and source-collection clustering.

arms.A: Eligible full documents plus a carefully prepared working note on a prespecified common eligible subset
arms.B: Lexical plus dense retrieval with registered fusion/reranking procedure chosen on development collections and frozen before testing; ordinary source metadata
arms.C: The same reviewed evidence, instructions and propositions as D, with relation meaning retained in linear prose
arms.D: Reviewed capsule and bounded typed micrograph

controls: Same source pool, question, model snapshot, instructions, output format, settings and output cap within each paired contrast
Freeze case-level graph and capsule annotations before disclosure of held-out questions; exclude builders from reference answers
Record task-time selection, information content and actual prompt length; do not call the complete D/B pipeline contrast a graph-only causal effect
Treat model choice as a blocked factor with actual hosted/local identities and route/resource records
Retain all failed, missing, timed-out and refused attempts in assigned-task completion
D/C retain equivalent information, including relation meaning in linear prose; report actual input tokens and run matched-budget sensitivity analyses
Disclose actual retriever, embedding model, reranker and indexing costs; use BM25 as an inexpensive ablation rather than the only primary comparator
Freeze the source collection and reviewed annotations before builders see held-out questions or reference answers
primary_endpoint: Valid completed output, appropriate handling or justified abstention on all prelisted critical points, and no consequential unsupported claim

review.assignment: Shuffled de-identified outputs and a frozen rubric; acknowledge incomplete blinding from content
review.adjudication: Record disagreements, agreement and sensitivity to adjudication
review.automated_judges: Secondary only after calibration; not the sole primary endpoint

analysis.intervals: cluster bootstrap with complete collections retained
analysis.secondary: D/C representation diagnostic, A common-subset comparison and subgroups; prespecify multiplicity procedure or label exploratory

mechanism_tests: typed organization versus same-meaning flat serialization

handover_study.design: Balanced recipient/task assignment with separate cases to limit carryover
handover_study.comparison: Ordinary documents/history versus capsule, artefact and inspectable graph
handover_study.extension: A bounded agent recipient under the same allowed actions and evidence

development_exclusions: existing reference fixtures and previously inspected answers
required_before_execution: fixed sample size and clustered power analysis
approved resources and spending for actual inference
cost_accounting: Count construction, human review, maintenance and revision; amortize one-time costs over observed reuse only. Compare quality at equal budget and total cost at equal acceptance threshold.
